sources.name: CommBank · application checklist
sources.finding: Salary-credit evidence distinguishes three months from six for casual employment. Self-employed evidence and rental alternatives vary. This supports conditional requests, not a blanket bank-statement pack.

sources.name: ANZ · home loan checklist
sources.date: Web page checked 19 Nov 2026 · excludes ANZ Plus
sources.finding: PAYG evidence depends on YTD history. Recent payslips may be up to 60 days old. Self-employed routes include one-year evidence or eligible company wages. Home-loan statements are generally unnecessary, with exceptions. Signed contracts come after approval-in-principle.

sources.name: NAB · application, page 2
sources.finding: Refinanced loans: six months of transactions, evidence no older than 90 days. PAYG alternatives include one YTD payslip or two of the last three, usually within 45 days; longer pay cycles differ. This separates history, quantity and freshness.

sources.name: Westpac · self-employed broker guide
sources.finding: Separate eligible Fast Track, one-year and standard two-year routes. Fast Track uses two personal ATO notices of assessment. Other routes can require entity financials. Do not silently put excluded standalone financials back into the collection catalogue.

sources.name: ING · mortgage application checklist
sources.finding: Useful Australian naming and older six-month loan / three-month card refinance references. Not accepted as current policy. Current initial broker requirements remain a gap. ING-V is a newer variation form, not a replacement initial-application checklist.

sources.name: ATO · income statements
sources.finding: Use ATO income statement. A PAYG payment summary is an alternative employer reporting document, not a tax return or notice of assessment. Keep the actual evidence route on the request.

sources.name: ATO · notice of assessment
sources.finding: The notice of assessment is the ATO assessment following a tax return. Request the correct financial year and keep it distinct from both the return and the ATO account statement.

sources.name: Hunter Galloway · supplied checklist
sources.date: Local one-page PDF read 19 Nov 2026 · publication date unknown
sources.finding: Compares common income, savings, liabilities and property evidence. Its three-year self-employed / six-month savings suggestions differ from the proposed baseline. Use as gap discovery, not lender policy. Original file is recorded in the research handoff.

sources.name: Aussie · supplied refinance checklist
sources.finding: Separates refinance purpose, existing debts, income and rates notices. Its older “Group Certificates” wording maps to the appropriate ATO income statement / PAYG payment summary route. Expense evidence stays outside this module.

sources.name: ANZ · supplied construction checklist
sources.date: Local PDF 08.2022; internally current at 29 Apr 2020
sources.finding: Deposit, progress and final draw evidence differ. Use it to justify a construction-stage input; do not import historical payment lead times or request final-stage evidence at initial application.

sources.name: Westpac · broker minimum documents
sources.finding: Pages 1, 3–8: TFN removal, PAYG alternatives, CCR-based liability/refinance evidence, staged building documents. Exceptions still refer to credit policy; a waiver is not automatic.

sources.name: ING · existing home-loan variation
sources.finding: Pages 1/10/19: applies to existing ING loan changes; applicable Section I uses a payslip under one month and salary-credit evidence if ABN is absent. Closure Yes/No is an election, not proof of a universal closure-letter requirement.

sources.name: CommBank · statement issue frequency
sources.finding: Home-loan statements issue in January and July. Request date coverage, not six monthly files. A statement closing balance is not a payout figure.

sources.name: Home Loan Experts · statements guide
sources.date: Checked 20 Nov 2026 · publication date not independently established
sources.finding: Distinguishes official statements from transaction histories and recommends pairing when ownership details/history are missing. Its CSV restriction is broker guidance, not a verified all-lender upload-format ban.

sources.name: ATO · definitions
sources.date: Official indexed definition checked 20 Nov 2026; direct page returned 403
sources.finding: IAS is similar to BAS but excludes GST and some other taxes. BAS, IAS and ATO account ledgers are not aliases; only BAS remains in this catalogue.

sources.name: ATO · finalising STP data
sources.finding: Payment summaries remain relevant for payments not reported/finalised through STP. Keep completed-year finalisation distinct from current YTD evidence; do not require an unfinished financial year to be Tax ready.

sources.name: Westpac · public broker policy
sources.finding: The page mentions both three and six months of rental history for genuine savings. Keep this purpose separate from landlord rental income; resolve the applicable route before issue.

sources.name: ANZ · paper application
sources.finding: Lists three months of home-loan statements if applicable. The web checklist generally does not require them. Do not erase this conditional channel difference.

sources.name: ANZ · general documents guide
sources.finding: Mentions self-employed tax evidence under 18 months; the detailed checklist uses different limits. No universal tax-age cutoff is adopted.

sources.name: CommBank · business-owner verification
sources.finding: Simplified verification pairs salary evidence with business-profit evidence or an accepted accountant letter. It is not the same as ANZ’s company-wage route or Westpac’s NOA-only route.

gaps: Approve proposed periods, identity combinations and evidence alternatives. The three founder statement durations stay locked.
Resolve current ING rules, retained loans, variable/foreign income, first-home schemes and other liabilities before automatic issue.
Prove loan/applicant/entity/account records, private upload scope, saved-file events and dynamic dropdowns in the target GHL account.
Approve receipt-pause, partial uploads, draft message copy and the restrained reminder schedule.
Excluded expenses, standalone business financials and other lender requirements need an owned external route. This module is not a complete credit assessment.

researchCrossCheck.summary: All eight report sections were reconciled against this module. Material changes were checked against original sources. Completed cross-check does not mean every lender route is approved or that every linked source was independently audited.

crossCheckFindings.detail: Keep founder 6m home refinance / 6m consolidated card / 3m retained card. Published alternatives do not silently override them.
Add statement-plus-history guidance where needed and accepted. One combined file can cover the period; overlapping files do not prove continuity.
These are different documents, not aliases. IAS and ATO account statements remain excluded; BAS stays.
Record financial year and finalisation status. Payment summaries still exist; Tax ready is not a blanket current-year upload requirement.
Review the route first, then preview a standard or reduced-document pack. No automatic eligibility decision or stacking of both routes.
The December 2025 form concerns changes to existing ING loans. It does not validate current initial broker requirements.
Store the reference event and date boundary. Thirty days is not always less than one month. NAB’s 45-day payslip rule does not become a retained-card cutoff.
Select the stage; request only its proposed items. Future permits, invoices and completion evidence stay out of the current chase.
Landlord rental income, tenant rent expense and rent-as-genuine-savings are different. Do not rename them all Rental statements; excluded expense collection stays external.
Add removal instructions and reviewer checks for tax file numbers. No automated redaction or privacy-compliance claim is made.
Record a verified lender-specific evidence substitution and owner. Existing customer status or a report alone must not remove requested items or tags.
Broker guidance against CSV is not a universal lender rule. Preserve readable originals/all pages and record accepted formats per approved route.
No universal passport-plus-licence pack. Keep the 70-entry menu and founder exclusions; unresolved identity combinations and excluded lender needs go to the broker.
An ING Yes/No closure election does not establish a universal closure-letter rule. Payouts, discharge authorities and closure evidence remain outside this initial module.
Keep ANZ web/form and tax-age differences, and Westpac 3m/6m rental-history conflict, visible for policy-owner resolution.
Do not encode the report’s 3.8% serviceability factor, inferred high-LVR card periods, shading, credit-score thresholds or universal LMI triggers. This module collects documents.
Check date is separate from publication date. Copyright, crawl and PDF modification dates do not prove current accredited policy. Historical forms stay historical.
Open Banking acceptance, variable income, unusual entities, scheme/state rules and native GHL access remain owner-reviewed gates. No credit-report or CDR integration was activated.

buildOrder.title: Prove the record and access model
buildOrder.detail: Create synthetic concurrent loans, two applicants, one shared entity and two cards. Prove each request and file has an unambiguous owner and permitted recipient.
buildOrder.done: No overwrite or cross-recipient exposure. Record chosen native GHL representation and any adapter boundary.

buildOrder.title: Register rules, fields and tags
buildOrder.detail: Use stable catalogue keys. Keep history, quantity, freshness and source/version separate. Create tags once; assign DC-07 sole writing responsibility.
buildOrder.done: The same person can need two different periods for two cards without adding period-specific tags.

buildOrder.title: Build intake and issue guard
buildOrder.detail: Broker selects circumstances, reviews proposed and approved requirements, records already-held evidence, ticks and confirms. Guard loan + revision before creating requests.
buildOrder.done: Drafts send nothing. Replaying confirmation does not duplicate requests or invitation. Unapproved selected rules block production issue.

buildOrder.title: Build upload and reconciliation
buildOrder.detail: Filter the request dropdown by authorised recipient and loan. Persist files before the receipt event. Support partial / ready-for-review and event retries.
buildOrder.done: Dropdown-only and failed save never remove tags. One card received retains the shared tag when the other is missing.

buildOrder.title: Build human review and amendments
buildOrder.detail: Accept, replace with a reason, withdraw or add requirements without discarding history. Reuse already-held evidence only with a review and request link.
buildOrder.done: Rejected evidence reopens only its request. No-longer-required items stop chasing without deleting evidence. Complete is not lender approval.

buildOrder.title: Connect restrained messages
buildOrder.detail: Approve the draft schedule and copy; map each placeholder. Compute the current list immediately before sending. Coordinate across cases to avoid recipient collisions.
buildOrder.done: No unresolved placeholders, duplicate sequences or sends after pause. A reply hands control to the broker. Cap exhaustion creates an owned task.

buildOrder.title: Audit the manual GHL build
buildOrder.detail: Run the synthetic acceptance pack in an authorised test location, then repeat after snapshot installation. Observe actual files, tags, waits and sends.
buildOrder.done: Builder records actual outcomes and evidence. Board checks alone never constitute GHL acceptance.

HighLevel documents multiple file links from form/survey uploads. Private request filtering, file history and validated persistence events still require a target-account proof.
Add Contact Tag and Remove Contact Tag are published actions. The builder must connect them to the authoritative request aggregate, not the selected dropdown value.

DC-02.why: After requests persist, invoke reconciliation before invitation.

At least one request needs client action.

DC-03.why: Dropdown selection, failed save and partial evidence keep the request outstanding.
Saved and ready for review: DC-07 removes only if no other request of this type needs action.
One or more committed receipts await broker review.

On replacement, only when the affected request requires client action again.

messages.title: Initial document request
messages.when: After confirmed requests persist; once per issued revision
messages.subject: Your document checklist
messages.body:
Hi [First Name],

Here are the documents we need for [Loan Purpose]:

[Outstanding Items]

Upload your documents here: [Secure Upload Link]

Choose the matching item in the upload list and follow its instructions. You can send what you have now and return for the rest. Please use the upload link for documents rather than email attachments.

If an item is unclear or difficult to obtain, reply without attaching documents or call [Broker Phone].

Thanks,
[Broker Name]
[Broker Phone]
[Credit Licence Details]
messages.guard: Use only the authorised recipient’s current list. Validate private link and every required placeholder. Do not promise all file formats are accepted.

messages.title: First outstanding reminder
messages.when: Draft: 3 business days after invitation, if still actionable
messages.subject: Documents still needed for your application
messages.body:
Hi [First Name],

These items are still waiting to be uploaded:

[Outstanding Items]

You can add them here: [Secure Upload Link]

Items already received for review are not included in this list. If you need help finding a document, reply without attachments or call [Broker Phone].

Thanks,
[Broker Name]
[Broker Phone]
[Credit Licence Details]
messages.guard: Fresh list at send time. No message for an empty list, paused case, recent reply or prohibited channel.

messages.title: One gentle check-in
messages.when: Draft: 4 business days after M02; SMS only if allowed
messages.body: Hi [First Name], it is [Broker Name]. Your remaining document checklist is here: [Secure Upload Link]. Need help finding an item? Call [Broker Phone]. Reply STOP to stop texts.
messages.guard: Use email alternative M02 if SMS is unavailable and permitted. Never send both channels for this attempt. Check expanded length and sender identity.

messages.title: Hand back to the broker
messages.when: Draft: 5 business days after the second reminder, if still outstanding
messages.body: Document follow-up has reached the proposed two-reminder cap. Review the current checklist, recent replies and any sensitive circumstances. Contact the client personally, pause or close the case. Do not automatically restart the sequence.
messages.guard: Assign an actual owner. Reopening an item does not reset the recipient contact budget.

messages.title: Receipt acknowledgement
messages.when: After saved ready-for-review submission; deduplicate by submission
messages.subject: Your upload has been received
messages.body:
Hi [First Name],

We have received this upload:

[Received Items]

Your broker will review it and let you know if anything needs to be replaced. Your checklist shows any other items still waiting to be uploaded: [Secure Upload Link]

Thanks,
[Broker Name]
[Broker Phone]
[Credit Licence Details]
messages.guard: Receipt is not acceptance. Never say the whole pack is complete after one file. Combine rapid uploads into one acknowledgement where feasible.

messages.title: Specific replacement request
messages.when: After the broker commits a replacement decision
messages.subject: A replacement document is needed
messages.body:
Hi [First Name],

Please open your checklist for the item that needs replacing and the broker’s instructions:

[Secure Upload Link]

Your other documents keep their current status. If you need help with the request, reply without attachments or call [Broker Phone].

Thanks,
[Broker Name]
[Broker Phone]
[Credit Licence Details]
messages.guard: Show the exact request and neutral reason inside the private checklist. Avoid sensitive account details in messages. Coordinate with the next reminder.

messages.title: Selected pack accepted
messages.when: After every active selected request is accepted; once per revision
messages.subject: Your document checklist is complete
messages.body:
Hi [First Name],

Your broker has reviewed and accepted the documents on this checklist. There is nothing further to upload for this set of requests.

Your broker will contact you about the next step. This confirms document collection only; it is not a loan approval.

Thanks,
[Broker Name]
[Broker Phone]
[Credit Licence Details]
messages.guard: Only after the accepted aggregate is true. Additional requirements later create a reviewed amendment, not a false original completion.

acceptanceCases: Self-employed Review first: no automatic tax/entity pack. NOA-only and company-wage examples do not stack standard returns; ineligible mixed structures stay in review.
Construction pre-approval: no permits, draw invoices or final certificates. Changing to a later stage generates only that stage’s proposed requests.
Change a request’s subject, route or period: previous held/unticked choices reset; unchanged requirements retain their decisions.
Six-month history: one complete file can cover it; six overlapping files cannot. Broker reviews accepted statement/listing combinations.
Current-year ATO evidence is not forced to Tax ready; completed-year evidence records finalisation and financial year. BAS is not substituted by IAS.
Later submission/approval date: broker reviews freshness and issues an owned amendment if needed; no automatic rewrite or unsolicited restart.
PAYG purchase before contract: request income / selected ID; do not chase an unavailable contract.
Refinance: home loan 6 months, consolidated card A 6 months, retained card B 3 months; all locked.
Joint applicants and trust: separate personal requests, link shared entity evidence explicitly.
Dropdown selection only, failed save and replayed upload: no premature removal or duplicate task.
Partial A, then ready A, then ready B: retain shared card tag until B is also received.
A different loan still needs card statements: keep the shared contact tag even when this loan is complete.
Broker rejects A: preserve files, reopen A, restore needed state; B stays in its actual state.
Pause or close while waiting: suppress next send; resume never clears DND or resends invitation.
Add or withdraw a requirement after issue: preserve accepted evidence and revision history.
Already-held evidence: confirm subject, period and acceptance before excluding from client chase.
Client replies / reaches reminder cap: pause automated follow-up and create an owned task.
Copy snapshot to clean test account: prove fields, private links, sender configuration and placeholders.
